body: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a new LARGE native-resolution pixel art game boss torso using the two references as design guides: reference1 is the existing frontal ink clock-tower body with blank circular face; reference2 is its separate stone clock rim/dial. Combine and redraw as one complete standalone frontal tower torso for a close-up boss attack. Maintain exactly the same identity: symmetrical pointed small tower roof, dark arch window above a massive round stone-rimmed clock dial, small stone shoulder supports, black ink lower edges. The circular dial is the main focal point and must be perfectly circular, FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC, empty near-black inside with only 12 simple stone hour marks, NO HANDS, NO FACE, no eyes. No arms, no fists, no chains, no ceiling beam. It must be detailed clean game PIXEL ART with deliberate 1px clusters at an approximately 400x460 native sprite resolution shown enlarged, NOT coarse enlargement of the references, NOT smooth illustration. Use only six flat muted gray colors: #171716 #41413D #575451 #817D77 #9C968D #D6D0C7. No gradients, no noise, no dithering. Symmetrical readable carved blocks with crisp modest dark edges. Large clock dial occupies bottom two-thirds, tower centered above. Include the complete clock circular rim and short ink drips below with generous transparent margin. Genuine transparent background. No text, no glow. This is a separated torso asset for animation; clock hands will be separate layers.
fist: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redraw the reference giant stone fist as a COMPLETE uncropped pixel art game sprite, flying horizontally RIGHT. Reference is cut along its canvas: restore full outer contours with 12% transparent margin on EVERY side. Subject: huge clenched medieval gray stone fist, four substantial block knuckles pointing right, thumb curled across palm lower-front, a short chunky cylindrical stone wrist cuff at LEFT, rear wrist connector facing left. Same muted stone/black ink material as reference. Do not show open fingers. Entire fist, cuff, thumb visible, nothing cropped. No long arm, no chain, no background, no effect. Precise hand-authored pixel art with deliberate small square pixel clusters, native sprite roughly 240x180, clean readable large flat planes, restrained cracks, no noise/dithering/blur/gradients. ONLY six gray palette colors #171716 #41413D #575451 #817D77 #9C968D #D6D0C7. Transparent background. Orthographic game side view, horizontal attack direction clearly right. No text or labels. Preserve reference character design.
